menu_options.local: One clock on this network (no cloud)

local.title: Doppler on this network
local.description: Control one clock directly, without Sandman's servers.

data_description.host: The clock's address on your network. A DHCP reservation keeps it stable.
data_description.dsn: The clock's network name, for example Doppler-1a2b3c4d.
data_description.local_key: The key stored on the clock (LOCALKEY in /data/doppler.db).

reconfigure.title: Change the clock's address or key

data_description.local_key: Leave empty to keep the current key.

error.invalid_local_key: The clock rejected the local key.
error.wrong_device: The clock at that address has a different serial number.

abort.already_configured: This account or clock is already configured.
abort.already_configured_device: This clock is already set up in another Sandman Doppler entry.
abort.reconfigure_cloud_unsupported: Only clocks added on the local network can be reconfigured here.
